title: Multi-index search of the same index prevents routing from working
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

Using multi-index search prevents routing from updating the URL when searching on the same index.

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

1. Go to https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/doc-code-samples/tree/isjs-v4/InstantSearch.js/multi-index-hits?file=/src/app.js
2. Change the second index to "instant_search"
3. Add routing to the search
4. Type and search term and the URL does not update

<!-- A live example helps a lot! Fork the sandbox, reproduce the bug and paste the URL here: -->

**Live reproduction:**

https://codesandbox.io/s/multi-index-hits-forked-xeby6

## 💭 Expected behavior

Expect the URL to be updated with the search term.
